newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF seeks 87,500T corn, 52,500T wheat.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF seeks 87,500T corn, 52,500T wheat.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) invited tenders for 87,500 tonnes of Chinese corn and 52,500 tonnes of feed wheat by 1:30 p.m. (0430 GMT) on Thursday, an NLCF official said.
The official said shipment for feed wheat was scheduled for July 17-August 5 if from U.S. Gulf/Europe or for August 5-24 if from the Pacific Northwest/Canada/Australia.
Arrival for the wheat was set for the two ports among Inchon, Ulsan, Kunsan and Pusan.
The tenders for corn were split into five lots.
Details for the tenders are as follows:
COMMOD TONNE SHIPMENT ETA ARRIVAL PORT
corn 20,000 Aug 17-Sep 5 Sep 10 Ulsan or Pusan
